title: pteris quadriaurita var. blumeana
intro: Pteris quadriaurita var. blumeana, commonly known as the four-leaf fern or Blume's fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Pteridaceae. It is a medicinal herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Pteris quadriaurita var. blumeana include antihypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its therapeutic properties and are being studied for their potential in the development of new medicines.
